items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: Carnish was an old friend of mine

ctx.x: Used to go back to, had the economy hall there. Not the economy hall there, Mason's Hall right? On the David Street then? I used to go to Buddy Bowling. Buddy Bowling. Buddy Bowling.
Buddy Bowling was one of the heaviest, loudest trumpet players that ever was in New Orleans. Him and Carnish. Carnish was an old friend of mine with a carnish. How did Carnish play trombone?
Is he really good on it or not so good?
